name: Local
description: Zero-key tools and free capability fallbacks that run on this machine: ffmpeg media tools and video upscaling, speech to text (parakeet-mlx, Hex, whisperX or whisper.cpp), Ollama chat, translation, embeddings and reranking, Kokoro speech, ComfyUI image generation and editing, Real-ESRGAN upscaling, rembg cutouts, Demucs stems, pdftotext, Tesseract and OCRmyPDF parsing, pandoc and LibreOffice conversion, and yt-dlp transcripts. Each backend is detected, never assumed.

comfyUrl.title: ComfyUI URL
comfyUrl.description: Loopback or private-network URL of ComfyUI. The host:port set here becomes reachable for this pack when it loads; the daemon's own port and metadata addresses never are.

allowRawComfyWorkflows.title: Allow raw ComfyUI workflows
allowRawComfyWorkflows.description: Let agents call local_comfy_run_workflow, which runs any API-format node graph on your ComfyUI server. Any node installed there can run, including custom nodes that read files, download models or reach the network. Off by default; local_generate_image (a fixed txt2img graph) works without it.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Loopback or private-network URL of Ollama.

kokoroUrl.title: Kokoro-FastAPI URL
kokoroUrl.description: Loopback or private-network URL of Kokoro-FastAPI.

whisperModelPath.title: whisper.cpp model path
whisperModelPath.description: Absolute path of a ggml model file (for example ggml-base.en.bin). Leave empty to search ~/.cache/whisper.cpp, ~/whisper.cpp/models and the pack data folder models/.

ollamaModel.title: Default Ollama model
ollamaModel.description: Model used by local_chat when none is given (for example llama3.2). Empty means the first installed model.

kokoroVoice.title: Default Kokoro voice
kokoroVoice.description: Voice used by local_speak when none is given.

transcriptionEngine.title: Speech-to-text engine
transcriptionEngine.description: Engine for local_transcribe and audio.transcribe. auto tries parakeet-mlx first on Apple silicon, then Hex, whisper.cpp and whisperX, whichever is installed; elsewhere whisper.cpp, Hex, then whisperX. Speaker labels always use whisperX.

parakeetModel.title: parakeet-mlx model
parakeetModel.description: Hugging Face model id for parakeet-mlx. Empty means mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.

hexModel.title: Hex model
hexModel.description: Model name passed to the Hex CLI. Empty means the model selected in Hex.

whisperxModel.title: whisperX model
whisperxModel.description: Whisper model size or id for whisperX (for example large-v3 or small). Empty means the whisperX default.

ollamaEmbedModel.title: Ollama embedding model
ollamaEmbedModel.description: Model used for text.embed and text.rerank when none is given (for example nomic-embed-text). Empty means the first installed embedding model.
